official_definition: You can put cards from your decktop facedown under one of your "The PartnerBurai Vrick", including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, until there are five cards under it.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Steel Load] or [Steel Load: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Steel Load]", "give [Steel Load]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
